proposals.rationale: LRASM and JAGM are both in this org's index, but the award is an indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity vehicle for design and development studies, technology demonstrations and engineering services across four separate weapon programs with no funds obligated at award — an umbrella services IDIQ of the kind §3 rejects, and no single line can claim it. JASSM and Hellfire are not this org's lines at all.

proposals.program_name: GERALD R FORD CI NUC AIRCRAFT CARRIER CVN 78-80
proposals.lexicon_quote: GERALD R FORD CI NUC AIRCRAFT CARRIER CVN 78-80
proposals.announcement_evidence: engineering and technical support for USS John F. Kennedy (CVN-79)
proposals.rationale: Rejected under §3's platform pattern: CVN-79 is a hull under construction that the contract supports, not the program the PE funds. The index carries no 'CVN 79' name — the nearest is a Ford-class RDT&E development line whose designator range happens to span 78-80 — and the announcement's money is fiscal 2018 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) plus fiscal 2021 RDT&E for shipyard engineering support, i.e. ship-construction support rather than the development line's own work. (The only other CVN rows in the index sit under BLI 0981 'Items Less Than $5 Million', a catch-all the loader excludes.)

proposals.program_name: Landing Helicopter Assault (LHA) and Landing Helicopter Dock (LHD) Modernization Program
proposals.lexicon_quote: Landing Helicopter Assault (LHA) and Landing Helicopter Dock (LHD) Modernization Program
proposals.announcement_evidence: USS Bataan (LHD 5) fiscal 2015 dry-docking planned maintenance availability
proposals.rationale: Rejected under §3's platform pattern and the O&M-on-a-procurement-line failure mode: the award is a depot-level dry-docking maintenance availability for one ship, funded with fiscal 2015 operations and maintenance (Navy), while BLI 0933 'LHA/LHD Midlife' is an OPN modernization line. LHD 5 is the platform being maintained, not the modernization program's own work.

proposals.announcement_evidence: This contract provides support for Los Angeles-, Seawolf-, Virginia-, and Ohio-class submarines
proposals.rationale: Rejected under §3 on two counts. The scope is generic services — 'engineering, technical, design, configuration management, integrated logistics support, database management, research and development, modernization, and industrial support' — and the Virginia class is one of four platforms the contract supports alongside Los Angeles, Seawolf and Ohio, plus potential foreign military sales. A class named in a list of platforms a support contract covers is not the program the SCN Virginia Class Submarine line funds.

proposals.announcement_evidence: The contract will support Los Angeles-, Seawolf-, Virginia- and Ohio-class submarines
proposals.rationale: Rejected under §3 for the same reasons as record 28 — this is the base award of the same N00024-15-C-2105 support contract. Generic engineering, logistics and industrial support spanning four submarine classes and submarine support facilities; the Virginia name is a platform in a list, not the program the line funds.

proposals.announcement_evidence: sustainment efforts and operations and maintenance services in support of Low Rate Initial Production Lot VIII F135 propulsion systems
proposals.rationale: Rejected as the exact failure mode the rubric names: O&M sustainment attached to an RDT&E line. The award buys sustainment and operations-and-maintenance services for already-produced Lot VIII F135 engines, while the only F135 name this org's index carries is the F135 Engine Core Upgrade, a distinct development effort inside the F-35 C2D2 PE. The same name also sits at 0604840M, so even the name does not pick a single line.

proposals.announcement_evidence: the procurement of AN/ARC-210 electronic protection radio equipment in support of domestic and foreign military sales (FMS) aircraft
proposals.rationale: Rejected under §3's platform/consumer pattern. The only ARC-210 rows in this org's index belong to BLI 4269 'UMCS-Unman Carrier Aviation(UCA)Mission Cntrl' — a line whose narrative names the ARC-210 because the unmanned carrier aviation mission control system fields those radios. This award is a general 1,160-radio indefinite-delivery buy for domestic and FMS aircraft with no connection to the UCA mission control system, so the line merely consumes the component the announcement names.
